item.title: Japan’s Takaichi says will take appropriate actions on FX if necessary
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said on Tuesday that she will make appropriate economic and fiscal decisions at appropriate timing. Takaichi further stated that she will take into account interest rates, foreign exchange and prices.

item.title: EUR/USD strengthens to near 1.1650 on Fed rate cut bets and strong German data
item.description: The EUR/USD pair gains ground to near 1.1645 during the early European session on Tuesday. The prospect of a US interest rate cut on Wednesday weighs on the US Dollar (USD) against the Euro (EUR).

item.title: Gold remains confined in a range as traders await more cues about Fed's rate-cut path
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) remains on the back foot for the third straight day, though it lacks bearish conviction and remains confined in a one-week-old range through the Asian session on Tuesday. Traders now seem reluctant and opt to move to the sidelines ahead of the FOMC rate decision on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD consolidates around $58 as Fed’s policy comes into spotlight
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades in a tight range around $58.00 during the late Asian trading session on Tuesday. The white metal turns sideways as investors await the monetary policy announcement by the Federal Reserve (Fed), scheduled for Wednesday.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD gains some positive traction amid dovish Fed expectations
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts some buyers following the previous day's two-way directionless price move and holds steady above the 1.3300 mark during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: BoJ‘s Ueda: Certainty of central bank's outlook materialising is increasing gradually
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Tuesday that certainty of central bank's outlook materialising is increasing gradually. Ueda added that he will adjust degree of monetary easing if economic and prices trends move in line with forecasts.

item.title: USD/INR retraces as FIIs selling momentum cools down
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) bounces back against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair falls to near 90.20 amid a slowdown in the pace of foreign outflow from the Indian stock market.
